sample.title: Backend Engineer
sample.description:
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing cybersecurity company at the forefront of securing AI-driven software development.

Cycode is redefining how organizations secure software in the age of AI-driven development. Our Agentic Development Security Platform helps enterprises secure the entire software development lifecycle, from prompt to runtime, through AI governance, deep contextual analysis, and autonomous security.

Powered by Cycode AI and Maestro, our orchestration engine, we help organizations identify real risks, prioritize actual exposure, and remediate vulnerabilities at AI speed. Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises worldwide, Cycode is recognized as a market leader in Application Security, Software Supply Chain Security, and ASPM.

Founded in 2019 and backed by leading investors including Insight Partners and YL Ventures, Cycode is building the future of secure AI-native software development.

As a Backend Developer, you will take part in all stages of development, from architecture and design to deployment and production ownership. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to build scalable, high-quality systems and influence technological and architectural decisions along the way.

Our stack includes .NET Core / C#, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, ArangoDB, Python, Terraform, Docker, and fully CI/CD-driven environments.

### Requirements

- 4+ years of experience with microservices development
- Deep understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-native development
- Experience designing and building asynchronous systems and working with message queues/event-driven architectures
- Experience with databases
- Experience in developing a SAAS product

Advantages:

- Experience in developing a security-related SAAS product.
- Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
- B.Sc in Computer Science/Software Engineering or related field
- Familiarity with the GraphQL framework
- Familiarity with the Graph Databases

sample.title: Backend Engineer
sample.description:
**Location:** Denver, CO office.

**Working arrangement:** Hybrid, approximately 2–3 days onsite each week

**Compensation:** $120,000–$180,000 base salary plus equity

**Employment type:** Full-time

**About the Company**

Join a venture-backed software company building modern infrastructure for satellite operations. Its platform allows commercial and government customers to command, monitor and operate different spacecraft and constellations through one scalable software environment.

The company was founded by experienced engineers and satellite operators who wanted to replace fragmented, highly customized ground systems with modern, reusable software.

- Approximately 70 employees with an engineering-led culture
- Meaningful equity and direct product influence
- Software supporting real commercial and government missions
- Small teams with significant technical ownership
- Opportunity to build foundational products rather than maintain legacy systems
- Collaborative environment spanning software, aerospace and mission operations

**The Role**

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to develop scalable, cloud-based software supporting satellite operations. The ideal candidate has strong Python and AWS experience, with the ability to build reliable APIs, optimize cloud infrastructure, and contribute to backend architecture and automation. Previous aerospace experience is not required.

**What You'll Do**

- Develop and maintain backend software for satellite ground operations using Python and AWS
- Design and build scalable APIs and integrate cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, and EKS
- Improve software performance, security, reliability, and cloud infrastructure costs
- Develop new features and troubleshoot issues across backend applications and cloud services
- Automate workflows and optimize cloud resource utilization
- Contribute to software architecture, generative AI integrations, and DevSecOps practices
- Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment processes
- Collaborate with frontend and backend engineers in an Agile Scrum environment

**Required Experience**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
- 3+ years of professional experience in backend or full-stack development, or equivalent hands-on technical expertise
- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience using GraphQL, Docker, and Terraform or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
- Experience designing, integrating, and troubleshooting APIs, including AI platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AskSage
- Strong understanding of containerized applications and Kubernetes deployments
- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EC2, and RDS
- Experience with Git-based development workflows using GitHub, GitLab, or similar platforms
- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on software quality, reliability, and performance
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with frontend, backend, and product teams
- U.S. Person status required; visa sponsorship is not available
- Must have active U.S. Secret Clearance

**Eligibility**

**Candidates must have an active TS/SCI clearance**, with the ability to maintain it throughout employment and work from the office under the required hybrid schedule.

**Why Consider It?**

Work directly with spacecraft systems, solve complex integration challenges, and help shape software used in real satellite missions.

**Outstanding benefits include:** unlimited PTO (minimum 15 days encouraged), 100% employee health insurance coverage, 4% 401(k) matching, quarterly wellness benefits, paid holidays, and equity.

**Interested in where this could take you? Get in touch for a confidential conversation.**

sample.title: Backend Engineer
sample.description:
Papaya is a leading skill-based mobile gaming company, bringing together fun, competition, and real rewards for millions of players worldwide.

Driven by our vision to create one of the world’s most exciting player communities, we develop games powered by a large-scale B2C platform that supports tens of millions of daily tournaments and connects players around the world through social competitions.

Located in the heart of Tel Aviv, we offer a fast-moving environment, culture of innovation, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a true impact. We are looking for people who play for real and want to shape the future of gaming with us.

About the Team:

WildCard is a product-facing backend squad in our Features Tribe. We own the systems that keep players coming back beyond the prize: the Store, Collectibles, Ranking & Seasons, the Friends social layer and the Gold Nuggets in-game economy. We work closely with Client (Unity) developers, Product and BI. Everything we ship is A/B tested and configured live through our internal back-office tool.

In this role, you'll design and build game features that keep players engaged over the long term by giving them memorable, enjoyable experiences beyond winning rewards. You'll work closely with Client developers, Product and BI to design, ship and measure features that directly affect our global player base. You'll also make our systems scale better and cost less, by building heavy API call volumes and taming request spikes when a new event goes live.

### Responsibilities

- Build and own a high-scale backend platform for millions of users.
- Lead solutions end to end, from challenging the requirements through design and production to measuring the results, with designs that shorten time-to-market.
- Own your systems in production: set up honest, actionable alerts and find the root cause of every bug.
- Build with AI every day: use Claude Code and our internal agent tooling to design, write, test, review and debug code. Help shape how the team uses it, including shared skills, internal connectors and agent workflows.
- Try out new technologies, tools and 3rd-party frameworks, and adopt them where they fit to deliver state-of-the-art tech.
- Tech stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Node.js, TypeScript, Redis, MySQL

### Requirements

- Minimum of 3+ years of proven, hands-on experience in the design, architecture, and development of complex server applications.
- B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a highly related technical field.
- Demonstrated expertise in cloud environment, with substantial practical experience operating within major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Experience in at least one major backend development language (specifically NodeJS, Java, or C#).
- A relentless drive to evaluate and adopt cutting-edge technologies to solve complex engineering challenges.
- Solid grasp of data modeling and caching: relational databases (MySQL) and Redis.
- A highly proactive, problem-solving mindset with a strict commitment to execution excellence and delivering production-ready code.
- Hands-on use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in real production work, not just autocomplete. You can explain how you break down tasks for an agent, give it the right context, and check its output.

Advantages

- Extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining high-scale, high-throughput distributed systems.
- Prior background working within the mobile industry, particularly in mobile gaming or large-scale B2C mobile platforms.
- Data-driven product work: A/B tests, working with BI, analytics in SQL (e.g. Snowflake).

Day-to-day spans design, production ownership, A/B testing, and AI-assisted development with Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes, Redis, and MySQL.

sample.title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure, Data Platform
sample.description:
### **Who We Are**

**Baton** is **Ryder**’s in-house product development group focused on harnessing emerging technologies to redefine transportation and logistics. With $10B in freight under management, our technology reaches every part of the U.S. economy.

We design and ship category-defining software that enables Ryder and its 50,000+ customers—including some of the world’s most well-known brands—to plan and execute freight intelligently, efficiently, and cost-effectively. Our work includes everything from customer-facing software to the data platform that will power the next era of innovation at Ryder.

**Baton’s mission**: enable supply chain on autopilot.

Ryder acquired Baton in 2022 to power its next wave of digital products. We operate at startup speed, with Fortune 500 reach. If you have a passion for solving complex problems and creating impact for the engine of the American economy, you’ll love it here.

* * *

**Role:** Software Engineer - Infrastructure  
**Department:** Data Platform  
**Location** Hayes Valley, San Francisco, CA

## **Basic Job Details**

**Job Type:** Full Time  
**Work Model:** Hybrid  
**Remote Days:** Monday & Friday  
**Office Days:** Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

## **Job Description**

As a Software Engineer on our Data Platform team, you will design, build, and maintain the core data infrastructure that powers Baton's near real-time streaming platform. You'll own data pipelines end to end from ingestion through processing to consumption, and work closely with data stakeholders across engineering, product, and ML to translate complex data challenges into scalable, maintainable solutions.

Baton's data platform is the backbone of intelligent freight operations at Ryder scale, and this role exists to accelerate its growth. You'll take ownership of our streaming and messaging architecture, contribute to data model development, and refine the API layers that surface data across the organization. Working within a high-trust, high-autonomy team, you'll move fast, operate in production from day one, and build systems that directly impact how Ryder and its 50,000+ customers plan and execute freight.

## **Responsibilities**

- Design and maintain a robust data streaming and messaging architecture.
- Ownership of our near real-time data streaming platform.
- Act as a technical liaison to ensure alignment of data strategies with business goals.
- Take charge of the entire data landscape, encompassing near real-time data ingestion, sophisticated processing, and efficient data consumption strategies.
- Collaborate closely with data stakeholders to simplify and solve complex data challenges, transforming them into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
- Everything from developing and maintaining data pipelines, enhancing data models, to refining API layers.

## **Required Qualifications**

- **Data Systems Expertise**
  
  - Demonstrates experience with real-time data systems
  - Relational table modeling and Event driven pipeline architecture
  - Working familiarity with SQL: Query Performance Analysis, Optimization, and Construction
- **Python Proficiency**
  
  - Advanced proficiency coding in python

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- 3-5 years of Software Engineering experience, with a preference for backgrounds in event-driven architecture or real-time data streaming
- Demonstrated interest or experience in the freight and logistics industry, with a keen understanding of its data-driven challenges and opportunities.
- Strong foundation in data analytics and big data technologies, with the ability to leverage these skills to drive insights and operational efficiencies.

## **The Perks**

- Competitive Base Salary
- Annual Company Bonus
- Long Term Cash Incentive Plan
- 401k with Matching
- Hybrid Work Schedule
- Comprehensive Health Coverage
- Hyper-Stable, publicly traded Enterprise
- Employee Stock Purchase Program (15% discount to market value)
- Collaborative, Tech-Forward, Cozy office environment in Hayes Valley

**Compensation Range:** The annual base salary range for this position is $162,000 - $216,000*

Compensation will vary based on factors including skill level, transferable knowledge, and experience.  
Note that the above is not the representation of total compensation, which includes our LTI Package as well.  
In addition to base salary, Baton's full-time employees are eligible for an annual company performance bonuses.

* * *

### **Why You Should Join**

- **Have an immediate impact:**
  
  - With Ryder’s existing customer base of 50,000+ companies and an internal headcount of 43,000, the scale and impact of our products will be large and far-reaching, from day one.
- **Opportunity to grow and lead in a Fortune 500 company:**
  
  - You’ll get to work in a rapidly growing, startup-like environment while having the stability and backing of Ryder and its full executive team.
- **Creative, fast-paced environment to solve impactful problems in Supply Chain:**
  
  - We’re going to design completely new tools for an industry that hasn’t been rethought in decades. And to do this, we need people who think differently.

sample.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
sample.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

### **Overview**

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, **accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices**, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

- **Application Modernization Execution:** Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
- **AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling:** Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.

<!--THE END-->

- **Consultative Engineering & Change Management:** Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
- **Hands-on Software Development:** Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
- **Feedback Loop:** Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
- **Standards & Quality:** Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

- **Experience:** **5+ years** of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
- **Full Stack Proficiency:** Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
- **Cloud Native & IaC:** Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
- **Consulting & Change Management:** Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
- **DevSecOps & CI/CD:** Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
- **Architectural Understanding:** Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
- **Communication & Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

### **Preferred Skills (A Plus)**

- Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
- Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
- Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
- Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
- Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

**Please Note**: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.

***Recruitment Notice***

Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
- Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
- If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

sample.title: Expert Online Services Software Engineer
sample.description:
# **Who We Are**

Founded in 2023, Small Axe is the newest stand alone studio at 2K looking to push game development boundaries to bring 2K's next groundbreaking sports franchise to life. We're building a world-class team at our new Vancouver, BC location where our goal is to deliver an exceptional experience through bold ideas, technical excellence, and creative collaboration. We're seeking passionate and driven professionals across all areas of game development to help shape this ambitious vision. If you’re interested in tackling unique challenges and think you have what it takes to level up our team, we encourage you to apply!

## **What We Need**

We’re looking for an Expert Online Services SE to help architect and build the scalable multiplayer backbone of our next AAA sports title. As a recognized subject matter expert in online services, you will contribute to the technical direction for our backend platform and own large systems end-to-end, primarily developing custom backend services and, where it makes sense, bridging that work into Unreal Engine dedicated server and client code. You’ll partner with designers, artists, producers, and engineering leadership to create seamless connected experiences while elevating the engineers around you. We value deep technical expertise, a collaborative mindset, and adaptability as our team and technology evolve together.

## **What You Will Do**

- Architect, build, and own large-scale backend services that power our online features, from initial design through launch and live operations
- Set technical direction and engineering standards for our online services, influencing architecture and best practices across teams
- Lead technical planning for major online initiatives, producing technical designs, work breakdowns, and dependency analysis that enable execution across multiple engineers and teams
- Provide input on infrastructure cost modeling and capacity planning, such as projecting cloud costs from expected player populations
- Partner with design, art, production, and engineering leadership to shape online features, clearly articulating trade-offs between player experience, cost, and schedule
- Set the bar for clean, performant, and well-tested code through hands-on development and code and design reviews
- Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, contribute to hiring, and help shape our engineering culture
- Collaborate with publisher technology teams, platform partners, and external vendors on online infrastructure and services

## **What Will Make You A Great Fit**

- 7+ years building backend services and online systems for games
- Expert proficiency in Go building production backend services
- Shipped and scaled live online services for millions of players
- Deep expertise in distributed, event-driven systems and networking protocols
- Proven technical leadership driving architecture and alignment across teams
- Production experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)
- Strong observability mindset, with hands-on experience building monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing for production systems
- Solid grasp of CI/CD best practices, with experience designing pipelines that enable zero-downtime deployments
- Excellent communicator, comfortable navigating a growing organization
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

## **Beneficial Qualifications**

- Experience with Unreal Engine 5 (or similar engines), particularly dedicated server and client networking code in C++
- Proficiency in Python
- Experience modeling infrastructure costs and capacity for live services at scale
- Experience integrating with first-party platform online services (e.g., PlayStation Network, Xbox network, Steam)
- Passion for playing or watching sports

**Job Ref Id:** JD-1339  
**Competence level:** Senior  
**Start date:** 2026-12-01  
**End date:** 2027-05-31  
**Scope:** Not stated  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Language:** English  
**Application deadline:** 2026-11-13

**About the assignment**

We are looking for a senior data analyst to join our data & analytics team. If you are passionate about data and eager to tackle some of the most exciting data analytics use cases in the fashion retail industry, join us. In this role you will play a crucial part in driving data-driven decision-making across various business functions including customer, sales, commercial, merchandising, product, supply chain, sustainability and finance. You will be responsible for identifying strategic challenges, conducting in-depth analysis and collaborating with stakeholders to turn data into actionable insights that support business objectives.

**Responsibilities**

- Key responsibilities:
- Proactively identify strategic challenges where decision support anchored in data is needed.
- Be the driver for data driven decisions making in your initiative/product team by taking data into insights and provide the team with clear, data driven recommendations.
- Apply advanced analytics methods and tools to model, execute and follow up initiatives from idea to industrialization.
- Be responsible for the full analysis process from problem and scope definition to data extraction, cleaning, analysis, visualization, creating recommendations, and presenting results.
- Turn business challenges into structured data analysis. Define and setup measurable KPIs and OKRs, own and maintain their visualization for value reporting.
- Be the data analytics expert in cross-functional teams and collaborate with business stakeholders to solve business challenges using data analytics.
- Work on a broad variety of business challenges with a wide range of business stakeholders (sales, commercial, merchandizing etc.).
- Participate in the wider analytics community, both internally and across the group.

**Requirements**

**Mandatory**

- To be successful in this role we believe that you have:
- Proven several years of experience as either as Data Analyst, Product/Business Analyst or similar
- Proven experience from retail sales, commercial, &/or merchandising business domain is must
- Have strong business sense and business interest with the ability of making sound interpretations of data and other information.
- Have excellent communication skills and are skilled in translating and explaining complex data analysis to non-technical and/or senior stakeholders.
- Have hands-on working experience writing advanced SQL queries to extract, prep, validate, and analyse large data sets.
- Have expert experience in Analytical tools i.e. powerBI
- Have previous working experience or comfortable working cloud platform data analytics i.e. GCP – big query
- Have skills in Microsoft excel functions such as power pivot, power query. Tabular Editor, DAX etc.
- Are prestige less and enjoy collaborating with others to solve problems.
- Are fluent in English

sample.title: Backend Engineer
sample.description:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world.

By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives.

Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

As a Backend Engineer, you will build and maintain the systems that sit between our AI and our customers: the APIs, data models and services that turn a continuous stream of detections into the dashboards and mobile apps our customers rely on every day.

You will work in a small, senior team with a direct line to our CTO, Product Managers and senior management, which means little distance between deciding something and shipping it.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable **leading projects**, not just completing tickets: taking a problem, scoping it, building it, and owning it through to production.

***This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates within 2.5 hours of Singapore's time zone.***

**What You Will Be Doing**

- **Design, build and deploy scalable backend systems** that power our AI platforms and our web and mobile applications.
- **Lead projects end to end**, from scoping and technical design through delivery, with real ownership of the outcome.
- **Keep things fast as we grow.** Apply solid data-structure and algorithm fundamentals so our APIs and database queries hold up as data volumes increase.
- **Collaborate with our AI, Product and Engineering teams** to shape the technical roadmap.
- **Conduct code reviews** and continuously improve the stability, performance and maintainability of existing systems.
- **Partner with our Infrastructure team** to roll out and manage cloud resources on AWS and other providers as needed.
- **Use AI to move faster.** Apply AI-assisted development tooling to your day-to-day work, writing, reviewing, testing and documenting code, and help the team get better at it.

**Our Ideal Requirements**

- **At least 3 years of professional experience with Python, and specifically Django**. This is a hard requirement, as Django is central to our stack.
- **Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms**, and the judgement to know when they matter.
- **Comfortable leading projects**. You can take an ambiguous problem, break it down, drive it to completion, and communicate progress clearly along the way.
- **Solid API and data modelling skills**, designing REST APIs and relational schemas that are clean to consume and hold up over time.
- **Experience with task queues and asynchronous processing**. Celery or similar, message brokers (Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka or equivalent), caching strategies, and handling high-volume event data. We rely on queues and brokers heavily, so this matters here.
- **Hands-on with AI-assisted development tools** (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar), and an instinct for automating repetitive work in your day-to-day.
- **Comfortable in a lean startup environment, working remotely**. Self-directed, communicative, and reliable without close supervision.

**Good To Have (Not Required)**

- Working exposure to AWS or another major cloud provider.
- Experience with other Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
- Some frontend or TypeScript familiarity — enough to debug across the boundary.
- Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or automated testing practice.

**Why Work At Ailytics?**

- Lasting impact at the intersection of AI and safety. Our systems are used daily by enterprise customers across Asia and beyond, in environments where a missed detection genuinely matters.
- We're a startup still in its early stages, so there's real room to shape both the product and the way we build it.
- You will work in a small, senior team with real ownership. You lead projects, make architectural calls, and see them in production quickly.
- We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.

**Job Category:** Full-Time

**Job Type:** Remote

**Job Location:** Remote

sample.description:
**Job Summary:**

At Modaxo, we're passionate about changing the face of people transportation. We believe that all transportation services should be safe, efficient, convenient, and equitable. Our products power mission-critical operations across a variety of industry sectors. We're making a strategic investment in AI to transform our solutions.

You will build the core services of a new enterprise AI platform - the APIs, orchestration, and data and integration on-ramps that our products build on. We ship working software on aggressive timelines; perfect is the enemy of shipped.  
You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: build the services an entire product portfolio depends on, with a clean slate and real ownership.

**Job Description:**

# **Why this role is different**

- It's platform AND product. You build reusable platform capability while enabling product teams to ship features fast - balancing leverage with velocity.
- It's domain-first, not tech-first. You'll learn our customers' operational domain; the best platform choices come from understanding how the work actually runs.
- It's pragmatic build/buy. We win on integration and reliability using proven components - pragmatic decisions, not gold-plating.
- It's a founding role - you help build the team. As an early hire you'll set the patterns, tests, and guardrails others build on, and help raise the bar as we hire.
- It's production-first, not research-first. We ship on aggressive timelines and own what we ship.
- It's value-based. You'll validate with product teams and customers and prioritize by value - building what moves outcomes, not what's novel.

# **What You'll Do**

## **Core Platform Services**

- Design and build core backend services - APIs, orchestration, and access control - as reliable, well-tested production systems.
- Shape API design and developer experience for internal and external consumers of the platform.
- Contribute to the reference architecture and design records; keep boundaries clean so components stay swappable.

## **Multi-Tenant SaaS & Integration**

- Build for multiple customers on shared infrastructure: isolation, quotas, and usage metering done properly.
- Build data and integration on-ramps - connector frameworks and governed data access that are idempotent and reliable at scale.

## **Ownership & Reliability**

- Own services end to end: design, implementation, tests, deployment, and on-call for what you ship.
- Model failure modes explicitly - partial failure, retries, consistency, back-pressure - and design for them.

## **Delivering Value with Product & Customers**

- Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritizing by value.
- Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
- Instrument and measure impact; let evidence - not opinion - drive what ships.
- Build automated QA - tests, quality gates, and regression checks - into the delivery pipeline.

## **Building the Team & Ways of Working**

- Help build the team: contribute to hiring, raise the bar in interviews, and mentor as we grow.
- Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and pragmatic shipping.
- Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

# **What You'll Bring**

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served - and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

- Production distributed systems: You've built and operated production backend or distributed services that other teams depend on.
- End-to-end ownership: You own correctness, tests, and operations for what you build.
- Trade-off reasoning: You describe systems by the trade-offs you made, not just the technologies you used.
- Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners, and customers, and bring people along.
- Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value and make pragmatic calls to ship.

# **Bonus Points**

Any of these strengthen an application - none are required:

- Multi-tenant SaaS: Backend services serving many customers with enforced isolation and metering.
- Gateways & orchestration: API gateways or workflow orchestration at scale.
- Integration frameworks: Connector or integration frameworks (API/EDI/CDC), not one-off scripts.
- LLM-backed services: Backend work behind AI or LLM features in production.
- Languages: Strength in C#/.NET or Python; Go a bonus.
- Architecture experience: System/platform design and trade-off judgement - one-way vs two-way doors.
- Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software and its reliability, security, and integration demands.
- AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

- Treats automated testing (unit, integration, and mocking) as a core part of development, not something owned solely by QA.
- Zero trust security mindset, including secure API development, secrets management, authentication/authorization, and avoiding common vulnerabilities (OWASP).
- Comfortable diagnosing production issues - from logs and performance bottlenecks to failed deployments and API/database problems - using logging, monitoring, and telemetry tools (such as Application Insights).
- Strong code quality mindset, including participating in code reviews, submitting frequent pull requests, refactoring, managing technical debt, and following team coding standards.
- Ability to understand existing systems holistically and work confidently within a large complex enterprise codebase including integrating with and modernizing legacy systems without assuming everything needs to be rewritten.
- Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Informatics, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

- Experience with backend testing frameworks (such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (such as Moq).
- Experience using AI agent tools for automated code review, test generation, or refactoring (such as Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or similar agentic coding assistants).
- Experience with event-driven/messaging platforms (such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ) and asynchronous processing patterns.
- T-shaped technical profile with deep expertise in backend engineering combined with broad understanding of agentic AI development practices and enterprise consulting.
- Active technical contributions or feedback provided to core AI platforms, open-source repositories, or internal frameworks.
- Experience modernizing or incrementally improving existing backend systems.
- Active professional certifications in backend frameworks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), or AI-assisted development pathways.
- Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related technical discipline.

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.
